synthesis:draft.headline: Tasmania 5-minute RRP peaked at 450.08 $/MWh at 2026-08-06 13:00 AEST (UTC+1000).
summary: There was one five-minute interval at or above the analysis threshold of 300 $/MWh in the window (intervals at or above threshold: 1; analysis threshold: 300 $/MWh) (ev0870, ev0872).
Dispatch TOTALDEMAND window minimum reported: 2026-08-06 02:45 AEST (UTC+1000) — 997.83 MW (ev0066).

Operational (30-minute) demand for the half-hour containing the price extreme (interval_end_utc 2026-08-06T03:00:00Z) was 1147.0 MW (ev0897); the window maximum operational demand reported was 1408.0 MW (ev0909).
Dispatch net interchange at the peak interval (2026-08-06T03:00:00Z / 2026-08-06 13:00 AEST (UTC+1000)) was 63.84 MW net flow out of TAS1 (export) (ev0436).
retrieve_public_evidence returned no AEMO market notice held specifically for TAS1 in the searched window (search outcome: 'no notice held for this region and window').

possible_explanations.statement: A rapid rise in dispatch TOTALDEMAND over the half hour into 2026-08-06T03:00:00Z (seen in five-minute TOTALDEMAND values ev0417, ev0420, ev0423, ev0426, ev0429, ev0432, ev0435) might be related to the price spike.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Compare pre-dispatch forecasts, pre-dispatch demand rebids and dispatchable unit bids for the intervals up to and including interval ending 2026-08-06T03:00:00Z; check whether forecast/offer changes align with the observed five-minute TOTALDEMAND sequence.

possible_explanations.statement: Changes in local generation output (SCADA changes observed in the 00:00–06:00 UTC window, e.g. large TVCCPS change ev0924) could be associated with the observed price interval.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Inspect unit-level rebid logs, outage reports and dispatch MW schedules for units with SCADA changes around 2026-08-06T03:00:00Z to see if bidding or availability changes occurred in the intervals immediately before 2026-08-06T03:00:00Z.

possible_explanations.statement: The net export at the peak interval (63.84 MW, ev0436) might be relevant to supply/demand balance at the time of the price spike.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Examine interconnector constraint/limit records, dispatch constraint notices and any interconnector capability changes for intervals up to 2026-08-06T03:00:00Z to determine if interconnector conditions changed near that interval.

uncertainties: Unit-level SCADA changes are descriptive observations and do not by themselves identify bidding decisions or outages (get_generation_change caveat).
